objective.text: Recognize that data_get's outer default is not forwarded to each wildcard leaf in the pinned framework.

difficulty.rationale: Trace the scope of a default argument through wildcard recursion in the pinned helper.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

options.rationale: The missing leaf is represented by the supplied default rather than dropped.
options.misconception: The missing leaf is represented by the supplied default rather than dropped.

options.rationale: The wildcard branch recursively looks up each child without forwarding the outer default, so the missing leaf uses null. To supply a per-row fallback, map each row through data_get with that fallback.
One missing leaf does not replace the entire wildcard result with the default.
options.misconception: One missing leaf does not replace the entire wildcard result with the default.

options.rationale: In the pinned helper, wildcard recursion does not forward the outer default to each child lookup, so the second missing leaf receives null.
